bindings.args: Capability arguments are bound into predicates under the `args` namespace; the executor flattens the parameter tree into dotted keys and substitutes args['...'] references as JSON literals at load time (wcd.exec_transaction._bind_args_into_envelope). The run-sheet consumes the same flat args ({args.script1_name} et al.), so one arguments dict drives both the gestures and the envelope.

Forbid clauses receive `scope` bound to the named fact's value and `scope_key` to its name, per wcd.envelope._build_bindings.
